category_title: Shy students with limited verbal output who require prompting to communicate ideas
minimal_context: The student is in a whole-class setting using an iPad app to narrate a story and add details to a character.
dialogue:
TUTOR: We are going to narrate the story for the class. Please add some detail to the main character.

STUDENT: He is tall.

TUTOR: What else can you tell us about him?

STUDENT: I don't know. Someone else can do it.

TUTOR: Just try to add one more detail to the incident.

STUDENT: He walked.

options.A: Direct the student to stop adding details and go back to reading the story on the iPad.
options.B: Use direct self-disclosure of a parallel personal tragedy to establish a deep emotional connection with the student.
options.C: Redirect the student to the iPad task fairly quickly and emphasize the importance of staying focused.
options.D: Encourage the student, by modeling, to put expression into his voice and use adjectives and adverbs within his sentences.
